The Maw

Region: the Grey Mountains

Connects to: the World’s Edge and Beyond.

Overview

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">The Maw is a great canyon that extends from the World's Edge deep into the Grey Mountains. Here the tropical heat of the lands beyond the World's Edge meets the snowcapped cold of the Grey Mountains, which results in great and unpredictable winds. </span>

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">Occasionally unwary travelers are yanked into the Maw by these winds, almost as if it hungered for human flesh. And indeed the Maw's howling winds often sound like the famished moans of a great beast. </span>

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">The dwarves of these mountains stay well away from the Maw, seldom venturing close enough to peer in, especially since an entire dwarven caravan was frozen solid by a sudden temperature drop after venturing too close to the edge of the Maw.</span>

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">However, some say that there are strange buildings to be seen at the bottom of the Maw fashioned out of great cyclopean blocks, with a wild river rumbling among them.</span>

Hooks

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">-How far northwest does the Maw extend from the World’s Edge? </span>

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">-What's at the bottom of the Maw?</span>

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">-Is it just a coincidence that the winds that howl through the Maw sound much like hungry moans? </span>
